flow: ui-path — click the composer model chip and read the picker panel (VERIFIED live 2026-09-23)

steps.note: No session snapshot needed — anonymous chat. Post-chat composer hides the chip, so start a New Chat if the previous step left one open.
Plain button, text like "5.6 Luna" (w≈100 h≈32, no aria-label), matching /(^|\s)(luna|gpt|claude|haiku|llama|mistral|kimi|gemma)(\s|$)|[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/i. If absent, click "New Chat" and retry once.
Row carries data-testid="model-picker-row-<id>", aria-checked="true" on the active model, text = "GPT-5.6 Luna\nBest for everyday use" (name + note).

rpc: No endpoint — the model catalog is EMBEDDED in the JS bundle (CAPABILITIES.md §1); the picker panel is the honest live surface. Selecting also rides the chat POST body 'model' field.
stealth: real DOM interaction with the site's own picker panel; chip click + row read are exactly what a user does. No synthetic request.
